host_scope: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU / sm_89 / WSL2 only

objective.primary: Decide whether GQA decode attention has enough measured headroom over the fastest correctness-eligible existing implementation to justify a new custom candidate.
non_objectives: implementing or timing a new custom attention kernel
claiming an isolated tensor probe is already deployment-equivalent
reusing K2 performance or correctness conclusions

authenticity_contract.formal_scope: decode Q=1 with output_attentions=false on the frozen C02 tape population
authenticity_contract.mask: contiguous BF16 zero mask [1,1,1,K] representing the all-visible decode cache slice

full_length_stratification.method: Expand every exact inclusive full-attention K range from the 11 census requests into a 21,694-element multiset, sort it, partition by round(i*N/12), and use the lower median of each slice as representative K. Multiply each slice forward count by 7 full-attention layers.

transformers_eager.definition: Frozen transformers eager_attention_forward with GQA KV repeat, QK matmul, BF16 zero mask add, FP32 softmax, and PV matmul; output tensor timed while its attention weights remain an internal materialized tensor.

compile_eager.definition: torch.compile(fullgraph=true, mode=reduce-overhead, dynamic=false) around the same output-only eager wrapper.

torch_sdpa_gqa.definition: torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention with the same tensors, mask, scale=1.0, dropout=0, is_causal=false, and enable_gqa=true.

baselines.best_baseline_rule: For each case choose the minimum p50 among every correctness-eligible baseline; aggregate the chosen per-case latency with frozen projected invocation counts.

correctness_protocol.input_distribution: seeded unit-normal FP32 tensors cast to BF16
hard_contract: all outputs have shape [1,1,8,head_dim], BF16 dtype, CUDA device, contiguous layout, and finite values
query, key, value, and mask contents and tensor versions remain unchanged
all 13 frozen performance cases pass for every seed

analytic_bytes.tier: Tier-A compulsory unique bytes for the output-only current inference consumer
analytic_bytes.formula: BF16 query + BF16 key + BF16 value + BF16 zero-mask slice + BF16 attention output; repeated KV views, materialized attention weights, and other implementation intermediates are not credited as compulsory bytes

measurement_protocol.interleave: four-way rotation by repetition index within each case

selection_gate.authenticity: PASS only if the census, OP1 receipt, and two channel-B observed decode shapes verify exactly.
selection_gate.bottleneck: PASS if the invocation-weighted Tier-A relative score of the per-case best correctness-eligible existing baseline is <=0.80 on a valid day.
selection_gate.native_path_precedence: If an SDPA baseline is correctness-eligible and at least 1.05x faster than current eager in the invocation-weighted aggregate, evaluate it as a configuration-only replacement before authoring a custom kernel.
selection_gate.custom_candidate_authorization: A custom GQA candidate may be pre-registered only after Authenticity PASS, Bottleneck PASS, and explicit comparison against any correctness-eligible SDPA path.
selection_gate.if_bottleneck_fails: Do not implement a custom GQA candidate; retain the valid probe and move the rolling backlog decision onward.
selection_gate.if_probe_is_invalid: Repeat the unchanged probe; do not reinterpret an invalid day as a selection result.
